infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the residential unit no. 7 inside the containment block in The Lab.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: TerraGroup Labs residential unit keycard (Res. unit) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A keycard to the residential unit in the containment block of TerraGroup Labs.

sections.heading: The Lab
sections.text:
- In Kruglov's office (R22) and the safe inside of it
- In different locations inside the containment block on the first level. A single keycard is guaranteed to spawn every raid.

sections.heading: First spawn
sections.text: On the desk in the security room (labeled 1) to the right after entering the block.

sections.heading: Second spawn
sections.text: On a red chair opposite the residential unit no. 7.

sections.heading: Third spawn
sections.text: On the floor next to a hazmat suit in front of the locked laboratory area.

sections.heading: Locked laboratory area
sections.text: To access this area, you need to open the locked door by turning on the power with the button located in the electrical operation room next to it.

sections.heading: Fourth spawn
sections.text: In the cup on the desk to the left after entering.

sections.heading: Fifth spawn
sections.text: Between the desk calendar on the desk to the right after entering.

sections.heading: Sixth spawn
sections.text: On the single desk to the right after entering.

sections.heading: Seventh spawn
sections.text: In a blue device on the middle desks.

sections.heading: Eighth spawn
sections.text: On the far mobile pedestal opposite the entrance, below the middle desks.

sections.heading: Ninth spawn
sections.text: On a cable box at the end of the hallway between the left and back glass laboratories.

sections.heading: Eleventh spawn
sections.text: At the whiteboard in the far right corner, on the marker tray.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Residential unit no. 7 inside the containment block on the first level in The Lab.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Loose loot (Valuables)
- Weapon spawns under the bed on the left
- Intelligence folder spawns
- TerraGroup "Blue Folders" materials spawns
